000001 01O||1|||1||In the beginning, God created the heaven and the earth.
000002 01O||1|||2||The earth was void and formless, and darkness was upon the face of the abyss; and the Spirit of God moved upon the waters.
000003 01O||1|||3|| God said: If there is light, there is light.
000004 01O||1|||4|| God saw that light was good, so he separated light from darkness.
000005 01O||1|||5|| God calls the light day and the darkness night. There is night, there is morning, this is the first day.
000006 01O||1|||6|| God said: There must be air between the waters to divide the water into upper and lower parts.
000007 01O||1|||7|| God created the air and separated the water below the air from the water above the air. That's how things came to be.
000008 01O||1|||8|| God calls the air heaven. There is night, there is morning, it is the second day.
000009 01O||1|||9|| God said: The waters under the sky will be gathered together in one place, and the dry land will be exposed. That's how things came to be.
000010 01O||1|||10|| God called the dry land the earth, and God called the gathering place of the water the sea. God sees that it is good.
000011 01O||1|||11|| God said: Let the earth produce grass, vegetables bearing seeds, and trees bearing fruit, each according to its kind, with the seeds in them. That's how things came to be.
000012 01O||1|||12||So the earth produced grasses and vegetables bearing seeds, each according to its kind; and trees bearing fruit, each according to its kind; the seeds contained seeds. God sees that it is good.
000013 01O||1|||13||There was night and there was morning, and it was the third day.

000015 01O||1|||15||And let it shine in the sky, and let it shine on the earth. That's how things came to be.

000022 01O||1|||22|| And God blessed them all, saying: Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters of the sea; and let the birds multiply on the earth.

002127 02O||22|||13||If a person is torn into pieces by wild animals, the guard must bring it as evidence, and there is no need to pay compensation for the torn parts.
002128 02O||22|||14||If a man borrows anything from his neighbor, and the one he borrows is injured or dies, and the owner is not in the same place, he who borrows from him must pay back;
002129 02O||22|||15||If the owner is in the same place, he does not have to pay back; if he is a hired person, he does not have to pay back, because he paid the price for his hiring.
002130 02O||22|||16||If a man seduce an unbetrothed virgin to commit adultery with him, he must hand over the dowry and take her as his wife.
002131 02O||22|||17||If the father of the girl refuses to give her to him, he will have to hand over the money according to the bride price of the virgin.
002132 02O||22|||18||A woman who practices witchcraft cannot be allowed to survive.
002133 02O||22|||19||Whoever has sex with an animal must be put to death.
002134 02O||22|||20||Whoever sacrifices to other gods, not just to the Lord, will be destroyed.
002135 02O||22|||21||Do not wrong the sojourner, nor oppress him, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
002136 02O||22|||22||Do not treat widows and orphans harshly;
002137 02O||22|||23||If I treat them a little harder and they beg me, I will always listen to their cry,
002138 02O||22|||24||And he will kill you with the sword in his wrath, and make your wives widows and your sons and daughters orphans.
002139 02O||22|||25||If you lend money to a poor person who lives with you among my people, you must not take interest from him like a moneylender.
002140 02O||22|||26|| Even if you take your neighbor's clothing as a pledge, you must return it to him before sunset;
002141 02O||22|||27||Because he only has this one piece of clothing to cover his head and cover his body. If not, what kind of clothes will he use to sleep on? He begged me, and I agreed, for I am merciful.
002142 02O||22|||28||You shall not slander God; nor shall you slander the officers of your people.

002145 02O||22|||31||You shall be holy before me. Therefore, you must not eat the flesh of animals that have been torn apart by wild animals in the fields, but you must throw them to the dogs.
002146 02O||23|||1||Do not join others in spreading rumors; Do not join hands with evil people to bear witness.

002152 02O||23|||7||Stay away from false things. Do not kill innocent and righteous people, because I will not treat evil people as righteousness.

002329 02O||28|||35||Aaron was to wear this robe when he ministered. The sound of his robe will be heard when he enters the sanctuary into the presence of the Lord and when he comes out, so that he does not die.
002330 02O||28|||36||You shall make a tablet of pure gold and engrave on it, as you engrave a book, HOLY TO THE LORD.
002331 02O||28|||37||Use a thin blue ribbon to tie the card in front of the crown.
002332 02O||28|||38||This tablet shall be on Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear the guilt of the law against the holy things which the Israelites have consecrated in all their holy gifts. This card is to remain on their foreheads so that they may find favor with the Lord.
002333 02O||28|||39 || Use fine linen threads of various colors to weave the inner robe, use fine linen cloth to make the crown, and use embroidery work to make the belt.

002336 02O||28|||42||Make them linen trousers to cover their lower bodies; the trousers should reach from the waist to the thighs.
002337 02O||28|||43||Aaron and his sons must put it on when they enter the tabernacle of the congregation or approach the altar to minister in the sanctuary, so that they will not bear their sins and die. This was to be an eternal decree for Aaron and his descendants.
002338 02O||29|||1||This is what you shall do when you sanctify Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish,
002339 02O||29|||2||Unleavened bread, unleavened bread mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers greased with oil; these shall be made of fine wheat flour.
002340 02O||29|||3||The bread shall be put into a basket, and the basket shall be brought also, and the ox and the two rams shall be brought.
002341 02O||29|||4||Let Aaron and his sons come to the door of the Tent of Meeting and wash themselves with water.
002342 02O||29|||5||You shall put on Aaron the inner robe and the outer robe of the ephod, and the robe of the ephod, and the breastpiece of the ephod, and the girdle of the ephod, the skillfully woven girdle of the ephod.
002343 02O||29|||6||Put the crown on his head, add the holy crown to the crown,
002344 02O||29|||7||Pour the anointing oil on his head and anoint him.

002346 02O||29|||9||Girded Aaron and his sons with turbans, and they received the priesthood by an everlasting ordinance. And you will consecrate Aaron and his sons.
002347 02O||29|||10||You are to bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on the bull’s head.
002348 02O||29|||11||You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
002349 02O||29|||12||Take some of the blood of the bull and put it with your finger on the corners of the altar, and pour all the blood at the feet of the altar.
002350 02O||29|||13 || All the fat that covers the internal organs and the net on the liver, the two kidneys and the fat on the kidneys are to be burned on the altar.
002351 02O||29|||14||But the hide, meat, and dung of the bull must be burned with fire outside the camp. This cow is a sin offering.
002352 02O||29|||15||You shall bring a ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
002353 02O||29|||16||You shall kill the lamb and sprinkle its blood around the altar.
002354 02O||29|||17 || Cut the sheep into pieces, wash the internal organs and legs, and put the pieces together with the head in one place.
002355 02O||29|||18||You shall burn the whole lamb on the altar, a burnt offering to the LORD, an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to the LORD.
002356 02O||29|||19||You are to bring the ram, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
002357 02O||29|||20||You shall kill the lamb, and take some of its blood, and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, and on the lobe of his son's right ear, and put it on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and you shall sprinkle the blood around the altar.
002358 02O||29|||21||You shall take some of the anointing oil and the blood from the altar, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and his sons’ garments, and they and their garments will be sanctified together.
002359 02O||29|||22||Thou shalt take the fat of the lamb, and the fat tail, and the fat that covers the inwards, and the net that is over the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon the kidneys, and the right leg (this is the lamb for the priesthood).
002360 02O||29|||23||Then take from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD, one loaf, one loaf mixed with oil, and one wafer,
002361 02O||29|||24||And they were laid upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, as a wave offering, to be waved before the LORD.
002362 02O||29|||25||Take it from their hands and burn it on top of the burnt offering on the altar before the LORD, an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to the LORD.
002363 02O||29|||26 || You shall take the breast of the ram that Aaron offered for the priesthood as a wave offering, and wave it before the LORD, and it shall be your portion.
002364 02O||29|||27||The breast of the offering, and the legs of the offering, are the ones that are waved and lifted up in the priesthood; they belong to Aaron and to his sons. You will become a saint in all of these,
002365 02O||29|||28 || As Aaron and his descendants’ eternal portion from the children of Israel, because it is an heave offering. This shall be a heave offering to the LORD from among the peace offerings of the children of Israel.
002366 02O||29|||29||The holy garments of Aaron were to be left to his descendants, so that they could wear them when they were anointed and wear them to receive the priesthood.
002367 02O||29|||30||His descendants who were priests after him had to wear it for seven days whenever they entered the tabernacle of the congregation and ministered in the sanctuary.
002368 02O||29|||31||You shall cook the flesh of the ram offered for the priesthood in a holy place.
002369 02O||29|||32||Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the lamb and the bread in the basket at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
002370 02O||29|||33 || They eat the atonement, that they may receive the priesthood, that they may be sanctified; but strangers shall not eat of it, for it is holy.
002371 02O||29|||34||If any of the meat or bread of the consecration of the priesthood is left until morning, it must be burned in the fire, and it must not be eaten, for it is holy.
002372 02O||29|||35||So you shall consecrate Aaron and his sons to the priesthood for seven days, according to all my commandments.
002373 02O||29|||36||A bull must be sacrificed as a sin offering every day. When you cleanse the altar, it will be clean; and you will sanctify it by anointing it.
002374 02O||29|||37 || Cleanse the altar for seven days and sanctify it, and it will become most holy. Anyone who touches the altar becomes a saint.
002375 02O||29|||38 || All you have to offer on the altar every day is two lambs one year old;
002376 02O||29|||39 || Offer this one in the morning, and that one at dusk.
002377 02O||29|||40||Whoever offers the lamb with it shall have a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of an hin of beaten oil, and a drink offering of a quarter of an hin of wine.
002378 02O||29|||41||The lamb shall be offered in the evening, as the grain offering and the drink offering are in the morning, as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.
002379 02O||29|||42||This shall be a continual burnt offering for you throughout your generations, before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. I want to meet you there and talk to you.
002380 02O||29|||43||I will meet the Israelites there, and the tabernacle will be sanctified for my glory.
002381 02O||29|||44||I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and I will sanctify Aaron and his sons, who will serve me as priests.
002382 02O||29|||45||I will live among the Israelites and be their God.
002383 02O||29|||46||They shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them. I am the Lord their God.
002384 02O||30|||1||You shall make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.

002386 02O||30|||3||You shall overlay the top of the altar, the sides of the altar, and the four corners of the altar with pure gold; and you shall make a gold edging on all sides of the altar.

003028 03O||11|||30||Gecko, dragon, palace guard, snake doctor, and scorpion.

003054 03O||13|||1||The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
003055 03O||13|||2||If a boil, a ringworm, or a spot of fire breaks out on a person's flesh, and a plague of leprosy develops on his flesh and skin, then he must be brought to Aaron the priest, or to one of Aaron's descendants who is the priest.
003056 03O||13|||3||The priest must look at the leprosy on the skin of the flesh. If the hair in the affected area has turned white and the leprosy is deeper than the skin on the flesh, then it is leprosy. The priest is to examine him and declare him unclean.
003057 03O||13|||4||If the fire spots on his flesh are white and do not penetrate deeper into the skin and the hair on them does not turn white, the priest shall lock up the person with the disease for seven days.
003058 03O||13|||5 || On the seventh day, the priest is to examine him. If he sees that the disease has stopped and has not spread on the skin, the priest is to lock him up for seven days.
003059 03O||13|||6||The priest shall look at the person again on the seventh day. If the disease appears dark and has not spread on the skin, the priest shall declare him clean, but it turns out to be ringworm. The man shall wash his clothes and he shall be clean.
003060 03O||13|||7 || But after he has shown his body to the priest to be cleansed, if the ringworm has spread on his skin, he must show his body to the priest again.
003061 03O||13|||8||The priest shall examine the person, and if there is ringworm on the skin, he shall declare him unclean and leprosy.
003062 03O||13|||9||When a person is afflicted with leprosy, he must be brought to the priests.
003063 03O||13|||10||The priest is to examine the skin and see if there are white boils on the skin, causing the hair to turn white, or if there is red bruised flesh where the white boils are,
003064 03O||13|||11||This is old leprosy in the skin of the flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and there is no need to lock him up, because he is unclean.
003065 03O||13|||12||If leprosy spreads out in all directions and covers the skin of the person suffering from the plague, according to the inspection of the priest, it will be everywhere from head to toe.
003066 03O||13|||13||The priest shall look and see, and if all his flesh is covered with leprosy, he shall pronounce him clean; and he shall be clean, and his whole body shall turn white.
003067 03O||13|||14||But whenever red meat appears on his body, he is unclean.
003068 03O||13|||15||The priests looked at the red meat and pronounced him unclean. Red meat is inherently unclean and leprosy.
003069 03O||13|||16||If the red meat is restored and becomes white again, he will come to the priest.
003070 03O||13|||17||The priest shall look and see if the place where the disease has become white, then the priest shall declare the person who has the disease to be clean, and he shall be clean.
003071 03O||13|||18||If a person has a sore on his skin and is cured,
003072 03O||13|||19||If a white boil appears where a sore has appeared, or a reddish spot appears among the white boils, it must be examined by the priest.
003073 03O||13|||20||The priest shall examine the person, and if it appears in the skin and the hair on it has turned white, then he shall declare him unclean, for the plague of leprosy is manifested in the sores.
003074 03O||13|||21||If the priest looks at him and sees that there are no white hairs on him, and there are no hollows on his skin, but there are dark hairs on him, he shall lock him up for seven days.
003075 03O||13|||22||If it spreads on the skin, the priest shall declare him unclean and a plague.
003076 03O||13|||23||If the spot of fire stays in its place and does not spread, it is a sign of a sore, and the priest shall declare him clean.
003077 03O||13|||24 || If fire poison occurs on the skin and flesh of a person, the blood stasis of the fire poison turns into fire spots, or it is white with red in it, or it is completely white.
003078 03O||13|||25||The priest shall look and see, and if the hair in the spot of fire has turned white, and the phenomenon is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy caused by the poison of fire, and he shall be pronounced unclean, and he shall be afflicted with the plague of leprosy.
003079 03O||13|||26 || But if the priest looks and sees that there are no white hairs in the fire spots, and there are no depressions in the skin, but it is dark, he will be locked up for seven days.
003080 03O||13|||27 || On the seventh day, the priest will look at him, and if the fire spots have spread on his skin, he will be deemed unclean and suffer from leprosy.
003081 03O||13|||28 || If the fire spots stay in the same place and do not spread on the skin, but appear dark and are the poison of fire, the priest shall consider them clean and only traces of the poison of fire.
003082 03O||13|||29||Regardless of men and women, if there is a disease on the head, or if a man has a disease on his beard,
003083 03O||13|||30||The priest shall look at him; and if the disease is deeper than the skin, and there are fine yellow hairs in it, he shall be declared unclean; it is scabies, a great leprosy on the head or on the beard.
003084 03O||13|||31||If the priest examines the scabies on the head and finds that the scabies are not deeper than the skin and there are no black hairs in them, he shall lock up the person with the scabies for seven days.

003471 03O||25|||1||The LORD said to Moses on Mount Siena:

003498 03O||25|||28||If you cannot get back for yourself what you sold, it will remain in the hands of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee; in the Year of Jubilee, the property will be sold to the buyer, and you will return to your own property.

003825 04O||6|||1||The Lord said to Moses:

003827 04O||6|||3||He must stay away from wine and strong wine, and he must not drink any vinegar made from wine or strong wine. He must not drink any grape juice, nor eat fresh or dry grapes.
003828 04O||6|||4||During all the days of solitude, you must not eat anything that grows on the vine, from the pit to the skin.
003829 04O||6|||5 || On the days when he makes a vow to secede from the secular world, he cannot shave his head with a razor, because the locks will grow out. He wants to be holy until the days of his separation to the Lord are fulfilled.

003831 04O||6|||7||When his parents or brothers or sisters die, he shall not make himself unclean on account of them, for the pledge of separation from the world and conversion to God is on his head.

004650 04O||30|||1||Moses spoke to the leaders of the tribes of Israel, saying: This is what the Lord has commanded:
004651 04O||30|||2||If anyone makes a vow or oath to the Lord and binds himself, he must not break his word but must keep every word that comes out of his mouth.
004652 04O||30|||3||If a woman makes a vow to the LORD when she is young and still in her father’s house, she must restrain herself,
004653 04O||30|||4||His father also heard the vows he made and the words he bound himself to, but he kept silent to him, so that all his vows and the words he bound himself would be finalized.
004654 04O||30|||5|| But if the day when his father hears it disobeys his vow and the word he binds himself, then it will not be determined; and the LORD will forgive him, because his father disobeys it.
004655 04O||30|||6 || If he gets married, has a wish, or makes rash words to restrain himself,
004656 04O||30|||7||The day when his husband heard about it, but he kept silent to him, and all the wishes he made and the words he bound himself were confirmed.
004657 04O||30|||8 || But if the husband does not fulfill his promise on the day when he hears it, then the Lord will forgive him even though he has broken his vow and has spoken recklessly to restrain himself.
004658 04O||30|||9 || The vows made by a widow or a divorced woman shall be determined by the words that bind her.
004659 04O||30|||10||If he makes a wish or takes an oath at his husband’s house to bind himself,
004660 04O||30|||11||The husband heard this, but he kept silent to him, and he did not refuse to agree to it. All the wishes he made and the words that bound him were finalized.
004661 04O||30|||12||If the husband annulls both of them on the day when he hears her, then the vows made in the woman's mouth or the words she binds herself will not be settled, because her husband has annulled them both; and the LORD will forgive him.
004662 04O||30|||13 || His husband can be firm in the vows he has made and the oaths he has made to restrain himself, or he can cancel them.
004663 04O||30|||14||If his husband is silent to him every day, it will be considered as firming up the vows he has made and the words that bind him; because the husband is silent to him every day when he hears it, it will make both of them firm.
004664 04O||30|||15|| But after the husband hears this, if he destroys both of them, he will bear the sin of the woman.
004665 04O||30|||16||This is the law which the LORD commanded Moses, a husband to his wife, and a father to his daughter, while the daughter is young and in her father's house.

023104 39O||1|||14||Cursed is he who practices deceit and has a ram among his flock, and who makes a vow but offers a crippled one to the Lord. Because I am a great king, and my name is feared among the foreign nations. This is what the Lord of hosts says.
023105 39O||2|||1||O priests, this commandment is delivered to you.
023106 39O||2|||2||For if you will not obey me and take glory to my name, I will put a curse on you and turn your blessing into a curse, says the LORD of hosts, because you will not take this commandment into your heart. Curse you.
023107 39O||2|||3 || I will rebuke your seed, and I will wipe your faces with the dung of your sacrifice; and you will remove it with the dung.
023108 39O||2|||4||You will know that I have given you this commandment, so that my covenant with Levi may endure. This is what the Lord of hosts says.
023109 39O||2|||5||We made a covenant with him of life and peace. I will give these two things to him, so that he will have awe in his heart, and he will fear me and fear my name.
023110 39O||2|||6||The true law is in his mouth, and there is no unrighteous word in his mouth. He walks with me in peace and integrity, causing many to turn from their sins.
023111 39O||2|||7||In the mouths of the priests let knowledge abide, and from his mouth men should seek the law, for he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.
023112 39O||2|||8||But you have strayed from the right path, causing many to stumble from the law. You have broken the covenant I made with Levi. This is what the Lord of hosts says.
023113 39O||2|||9||Therefore We have made you despised and despised by everyone, because you do not keep My way, but show partiality to the law.
023114 39O||2|||10||Aren’t we all a father? Is it not created by one God? How come each of us treats our brothers treacherously and breaks the covenant God made with our ancestors?
023115 39O||2|||11||The children of Judah acted deceitfully and committed an abomination in Israel and Jerusalem; for they had profaned the holiness of the LORD, the love of the LORD, and married those who served foreign gods. The woman is the wife.
023116 39O||2|||12||Whoever does this, whoever brings an offering to the LORD of hosts, the LORD will cut him off from the tents of Jacob.
023117 39O||2|||13||You have done another thing like this, causing your ex-wife to cover the altar of the LORD with sighs and weeping tears, so that the LORD no longer looks at the offering, nor accepts it with pleasure from your hands.
023118 39O||2|||14||You also say: Why is this? For the LORD is his witness between you and the wife of your youth. Although he is your spouse and your covenant wife, you have treated him treacherously.
023119 39O||2|||15||Although God has the remaining power of the spirit to create many people, doesn’t He create just one person? Why create only one human being? It is because he wants people to have pious descendants. Therefore, guard your hearts, and no one should treat the wife of your youth in a deceitful manner.
023120 39O||2|||16||The LORD, the God of Israel, says: I hate anyone who divorces his wife and whoever treats her with violence. Therefore, you should guard your hearts and do not act deceitfully. This is what the Lord of hosts says.
023121 39O||2|||17||You have troubled the LORD with your words, and you say: In what matter have we troubled him? For you say: Whoever does evil does good in the sight of the Lord, and he is pleased with them; or, Where is the God of righteousness?
023122 39O||3|||1||The LORD of hosts says: I will send my messenger who will prepare the way before me. The Lord whom you seek will suddenly enter his temple; the messenger of the covenant, whom you admire, will come soon.
023123 39O||3|||2||Who can be worthy of the day when he comes? When he appears, who will be able to stand immediately? Because he is like the fire of a person who refines gold, or the alkali of a person who bleaches cloth.
023124 39O||3|||3||He will sit down as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the Levites and refine them like gold and silver, so that they can offer their offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
023125 39O||3|||4||Then the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will be acceptable to the Lord, as in the days of old, and in the years of old.
023126 39O||3|||5 || I will come to you to judge you, says the LORD of hosts. I will bear witness quickly and warn against those who practice sorcery, those who commit adultery, those who swear false oaths, those who betray people's wages, those who oppress widows and orphans, those who live in vain, and those who do not fear me.
023127 39O||3|||6||Because I, the LORD, do not change, you sons of Jacob do not perish.
023128 39O||3|||7||The LORD of hosts says: From the days of your fathers you have always strayed from my ordinances and have not kept them. Now if you want to turn to me, I will turn to you. But you ask: How can we turn?
023129 39O||3|||8||How can man take away the things of God? You actually took away our offerings. But you say: For what reason have we taken away your offerings? It is for you to pay the tithe and the offering for the Lord.
023130 39O||3|||9||Because you, the whole nation, rob us of our offerings, a curse is upon you.
023131 39O||3|||10||The LORD of hosts says: Bring a full tenth of what is due to you into the storehouse, so that there may be food in my house, to test me whether I will open the windows of heaven for you and pour out blessings to you, so that there will be no room for it.
023132 39O||3|||11||The LORD of hosts says: I will rebuke the locusts (devourers) for you, and I will not allow them to destroy your produce. The vines in your fields will not drop their fruit before they are ripe.
023133 39O||3|||12 || The nations will call you blessed, says the LORD of hosts, for your land will be a land of joy.
023134 39O||3|||13||The LORD says: You have spoken against me with words, and you say: With what words have we spoken against you?
023135 39O||3|||14||You say: It is in vain to serve God. What good does it do to keep what God has commanded and to suffer and fast before the LORD of hosts?
023136 39O||3|||15||Now we call the proud blessed, and those who do evil are established; they test God, but are saved from trouble.
023137 39O||3|||16||Then those who feared the LORD talked among themselves, and the LORD listened, and a book of remembrance was before him, a record of those who feared the LORD and remembered his name.
023138 39O||3|||17 || They shall be mine on the day which I have appointed, saith the LORD of hosts, and they shall be mine especially. I will have pity on them, just as a man has pity and service on his own son.
023139 39O||3|||18||Then you will return and separate the righteous from the evil, those who serve God from those who do not serve Him.
023140 39O||4|||1||The LORD of hosts says: That day is coming, like a burning furnace, and all the proud and those who do evil will be like stubble; they will be burned up in that day, and not a branch or a branch will be left alive.
023141 39O||4|||2||But to you who fear my name, the Sun of Righteousness will arise, whose rays (literally, wings) have the power to heal. You will come out and jump like fatted calves from the pen.
023142 39O||4|||3||You will trample down the wicked; they will be as dust under the soles of your feet on the day I have appointed. This is what the Lord of hosts says.
023143 39O||4|||4 || Remember the law of my servant Moses, which I commanded him in Mount Horeb to all the Israelites.
023144 39O||4|||5||Behold, I will send you the prophet Elijah before the great and awesome day of the LORD comes.
023145 39O||4|||6||He will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and send a curse upon the earth.
023146 40N||1|||1||The descendants of Abraham, the descendants of David (the original text of the descendants are all called sons, the same below), the genealogy of Jesus Christ:
023147 40N||1|||2||Abraham begat Isaac; Isaac begat Jacob; Jacob begat Judah and his brothers;
023148 40N||1|||3||Judah begat Pharez and Zerah from Tamar's family; Pharez begat Hezron; Hezron begat Aram;
023149 40N||1|||4||Aram was the father of Ammi-nadad; Ammi-nadad was the father of Nahshon; Nahshon was the father of Salmon;
023150 40N||1|||5||Samon was the father of Boaz, the son of Rahab; and Boaz was the father of Obed, the son of Ruth; and Obed was the father of Jesse;
023151 40N||1|||6||Jesse begat King David. David begat Solomon by Uriah’s wife;
023152 40N||1|||7||Solomon begat Rehoboam; Rehoboam begat Abijah; Abijah begat Asa;
023153 40N||1|||8||Asa begat Jehoshaphat; Jehoshaphat begat Joram; Jehoram begat Uzziah;
023154 40N||1|||9||Uzziah begat Jotham; Jotham begat Ahaz; Ahaz begat Hezekiah;
023155 40N||1|||10||Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh; Manasseh was the father of Abe; Abe was the father of Josiah;
023156 40N||1|||11||When the people were transferred to Babylon, Josiah begat Jeconiah and his brothers.
023157 40N||1|||12||After they moved to Babylon, Jeconiah became the father of Shealtiel, and Sarahtiel was the father of Zerubbabel;
023158 40N||1|||13|| Zerubbabel was the father of Abiyu; Abiyu was the father of Elijah; Elijah was the father of Azor;
023159 40N||1|||14|| Zadok was the father of Ah; Zadok was the father of Ahakim; Ahakim was the father of Erod;
023160 40N||1|||15||Eluth begat Eleazar; Eleazar begat Mattan; Mattan begat Jacob;
023161 40N||1|||16||Jacob begat Joseph, the husband of Mary. Jesus, who is called Christ, was born of Mary.
023162 40N||1|||17||So from Abraham to David there were fourteen generations; from David to the time of the exodus to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the time of the exodus to Babylon to Christ, fourteen more generations.
023163 40N||1|||18||The events of the birth of Jesus Christ are as follows: His mother Mary was already betrothed to Joseph, but before they were married, Mary became pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
023164 40N||1|||19||His husband Joseph was a righteous man and did not want to humiliate him openly. He wanted to divorce him secretly.
023165 40N||1|||20||While he was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, "Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid!" Just bring your wife Mary, for the pregnancy in her is from the Holy Spirit.
023166 40N||1|||21||He will give birth to a son, and you are to name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.
023167 40N||1|||22||All these things were accomplished in order to fulfill what the Lord had spoken through the prophet,
023168 40N||1|||23 || Say: A virgin will conceive and bear a son; and they will call his name Immanuel. (Emmanuel translates it as God with us.)
023169 40N||1|||24||Joseph woke up and got up, and he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him and took his wife to him;
023170 40N||1|||25||But she did not sleep with him, and when he gave birth to a son (there are ancient scrolls: when he gave birth to his first son), he named him Jesus.
023171 40N||2|||1||Jesus was born in Bethlehem, Judea, during the time of King Herod. Some wise men came to Jerusalem from the East and said:
023172 40N||2|||2||Where is he who is born King of the Jews? We see his star in the east and come to pay homage to him.
023173 40N||2|||3||When King Herod heard this, he was troubled, and all the people in Jerusalem and the whole city were troubled.
023174 40N||2|||4||So he called together the chief priests and scribes of the people, and asked them, Where was Christ supposed to be born?
023175 40N||2|||5||They answered and said: In Bethlehem of Judea. For a prophet wrote, saying:
023176 40N||2|||6 || O Bethlehem in the land of Judah, you are not the least among the cities of Judah; for out of you will come a king who will shepherd my people Israel.
023177 40N||2|||7||At that moment, Herod secretly summoned the doctors and asked in detail when the star appeared.
023178 40N||2|||8||And he sent them to Bethlehem, saying, "Go and search carefully for the little child. If you find him, come and report him, so that I may go and pay him homage."
023179 40N||2|||9||When they heard what the king said, they went away. The star seen in the east suddenly moved in front of them, went straight to the child's place, and stopped above them.
023180 40N||2|||10||When they saw the star, they rejoiced greatly;
023181 40N||2|||11||When he entered the house, he saw the child and his mother Mary. He fell down and worshiped the child. He opened the treasure box and gave him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
023182 40N||2|||12||The wise men went back to their hometown by another way because they were told by the Lord in a dream not to go back to see Herod.
023183 40N||2|||13||After they had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, Arise! Take the child and his mother and flee to Egypt, and stay there until I command you; for Herod will be looking for the child to destroy him.
023184 40N||2|||14||So Joseph got up and took the child and his mother at night and went to Egypt,
023185 40N||2|||15||He lived there until Herod died. This was to fulfill what the Lord had spoken through the prophet, saying: Out of Egypt I called my Son.
023186 40N||2|||16||When Herod saw that he had been fooled by the wise men, he became very angry and sent for all the boys in the city of Bethlehem and in all its surroundings, and they killed all the boys under two years old and under, as he examined the wise men.
023187 40N||2|||17||This is in accordance with the words of the prophet Jeremiah, who said:
023188 40N||2|||18||And in Ramah there was heard a sound of wailing and wailing, and it was Rachel weeping for her children, who refused to be comforted, because they were no longer there.
023189 40N||2|||19||After the death of Herod, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream in Egypt, saying:
023190 40N||2|||20||Get up! Take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel, because the person who wanted to kill the child is dead.
023191 40N||2|||21||Joseph got up and took the child and his mother to the land of Israel;
023192 40N||2|||22|| But because he had heard that Archelaus had succeeded his father Herod as king of the Jews, he was afraid to go there, and he was warned by the Lord in a dream, so he went to the territory of Galilee,
023193 40N||2|||23||And he came to a city called Nazareth, and he dwelt there. This was to fulfill the prophet's word that he would be called a Nazarene.
023194 40N||3|||1||At that time John the Baptist went out and preached in the wilderness of Judea, saying:
023195 40N||3|||2||The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand, you should repent!
023196 40N||3|||3||This is the man of whom the prophet Isaiah spoke. He said: There is a voice crying in the wilderness, saying: Prepare the way of the Lord, make His paths straight!
023197 40N||3|||4||This John was dressed in camel hair and had a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
023198 40N||3|||5||At that time all the people from Jerusalem and all Judea and the region around the Jordan went out to John,
023199 40N||3|||6||Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the river Jordan.
023200 40N||3|||7||When John saw many Pharisees and Caesareans coming to be baptized, he said to them, “You are a brood of vipers!” Who instructs you to flee from the wrath to come?
023201 40N||3|||8||You must bear fruit in keeping with a repentant spirit.
023202 40N||3|||9||Do not say in your heart: We have Abraham as our ancestor. I tell you, God was able to raise up descendants for Abraham from these stones.
023203 40N||3|||10||Now that the ax has been placed at the root of the tree, any tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
023204 40N||3|||11||I baptize you with water for repentance. But he who comes after me has greater ability than I do, and I am not worthy even to carry his shoes. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
023205 40N||3|||12|| He has a winnowing fan in his hand to clear his farm, gather the wheat into his barn and burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
023206 40N||3|||13||Now Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan River and met John to be baptized by him.
023207 40N||3|||14||John wanted to stop him and said: I should be baptized by you, and you come to me instead?
023208 40N||3|||15||Jesus answered and said to him: Allow me for now, for in this way it is our duty to fulfill all righteousness. So John promised him.
023209 40N||3|||16||Jesus was baptized and immediately came up from the water. Suddenly the heavens opened for him, and he saw the spirit of God descending like a dove and landing on him.
023210 40N||3|||17||There was a voice from heaven saying: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
023211 40N||4|||1||At that time, Jesus was led by the Holy Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
023212 40N||4|||2||He fasted for forty days and nights, and then he became hungry.
023213 40N||4|||3||The tempter came to him and said to him: If you are the Son of God, command these stones to become bread.
023214 40N||4|||4||But Jesus answered and said, It is written: Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth from the mouth of God.
023215 40N||4|||5||The devil took him into the holy city and made him stand on the top of the temple (top: the original text is the wing),
023216 40N||4|||6 || Say to him: If you are the Son of God, jump down, for it is written: The Lord will command his angels for you, to hold you up with their hands, so that you will not dash your feet against a stone.
023217 40N||4|||7||Jesus said to him: It is also written, You shall not tempt the Lord your God.
023218 40N||4|||8||The devil took him up to the highest mountain and showed him all the kingdoms in the world and their glory.
023219 40N||4|||9 || Say to him: If you fall down and worship me, I will give you all this.
023220 40N||4|||10||Jesus said: Satan (Satan means resist, which is another name for the devil), get away! For it is written: Worship the Lord your God, and Him only shall you serve.
023221 40N||4|||11||So the devil left Jesus, and angels came to wait on Him.
023222 40N||4|||12||When Jesus heard that John was put in prison, he withdrew to Galilee;
023223 40N||4|||13||Then he left Nazareth and went to Capernaum, and stayed there. That place was by the sea, on the border of Zebulun and Naphtali.
023224 40N||4|||14||This was to fulfill the words of the prophet Isaiah,
023225 40N||4|||15 || Say: The land of Zebulun, the land of Naphtali, that is, the land of the Gentiles, Galilee, by the sea, about beyond the river Dan.
023226 40N||4|||16||The people who sat in darkness saw the great light; and those who sat in the land of the shadow of death saw that the light shone upon them.
023227 40N||4|||17|| From that time Jesus began to preach, saying: The kingdom of heaven is at hand; repent!
023228 40N||4|||18||As Jesus was walking by the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon who was called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea; they were fishermen.
023229 40N||4|||19||Jesus said to them: Come, follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
023230 40N||4|||20||They immediately abandoned the net and followed him.
023231 40N||4|||21||As he went on from there, he saw two brothers, James son of Zebedee, and his brother John, in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending nets; and Jesus called them,
023232 40N||4|||22 || Immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Jesus.
023233 40N||4|||23||Jesus traveled throughout Galilee, teaching in synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all kinds of diseases among the people.
023234 40N||4|||24||His fame spread throughout Syria. The people there brought them all who were sick, those who had all kinds of diseases and pains, those who were possessed by demons, those who had epilepsy, and those who were paralyzed, and Jesus healed them.
023235 40N||4|||25||Now a great number of people came with him from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
023236 40N||5|||1||When Jesus saw the crowd, he went up a mountain. And when he had sat down, his disciples came to him,
023237 40N||5|||2||He opened his mouth and taught them a lesson, saying:
023238 40N||5|||3||Blessed are those who are humble in spirit! Because the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.
023239 40N||5|||4||Blessed are those who mourn! Because they will be comforted.
023240 40N||5|||5||Blessed are gentle people! Because they must inherit the earth.
023241 40N||5|||6||Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness! Because they will be satisfied.
023242 40N||5|||7||Blessed are those who show mercy to others! Because they will receive mercy.
023243 40N||5|||8||Blessed are those who have a pure heart! Because they must see God.
023244 40N||5|||9||Blessed are those who make peace! Because they will be called sons of God.
023245 40N||5|||10||Blessed are those who suffer persecution for righteousness’ sake! Because the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.
023246 40N||5|||11||Blessed are you if people insult you, persecute you, and fabricate all kinds of evil things to slander you because of me!
023247 40N||5|||12||Rejoice and be glad, for your reward in heaven is great. The prophets who were before you were also persecuted in this way.
023248 40N||5|||13||You are the salt of the world. If the salt loses its taste, how can you make it taste salty again? It will be of no use in the future, but will be thrown outside and trampled on by others.
023249 40N||5|||14||You are the light of the world. A city built on a mountain cannot be hidden.
023250 40N||5|||15||When people light a lamp, they put it not under a bushel but on a lampstand, so that it can give light to the whole family.
023251 40N||5|||16 || Let your light so shine before others, that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.
023252 40N||5|||17||Do not think that I have come to destroy the Law and the Prophets. I came not to destroy you, but to perfect you.
023253 40N||5|||18||Truly, I say to you, until heaven and earth pass away, not one jot or one tittle of the law will pass away until all of it is fulfilled.
023254 40N||5|||19||Therefore, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do the same, he will be called the least in the kingdom of heaven. But whoever obeys this commandment and teaches others to obey it, he will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
023255 40N||5|||20 || I say to you, unless your righteousness exceeds the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
023256 40N||5|||21||You have heard that it was commanded to the ancients, saying: Thou shalt not kill; and also saying: Whoever kills will be judged.
023257 40N||5|||22 || But I tell you: Anyone who (some ancient scrolls add under the word fan: without reason or reason) is angry with a brother will inevitably be judged; whoever calls a brother a laca will inevitably be judged by the Sanhedrin; whoever scolds a brother will inevitably be judged by the Sanhedrin. My brother is a victim of the devil and will inevitably suffer the fire of hell.
023258 40N||5|||23||So, when you are offering your gift on the altar, if you remember that your brother has a grudge against you,
023259 40N||5|||24||Leave the gift in front of the altar, go and make peace with your brothers, and then come and offer the gift.
023260 40N||5|||25 || If your enemy who is suing you is still on the road, make peace with him as soon as possible, lest he send you to the judge, and the judge hands you over to the Yamen, and you will be thrown into prison.
023261 40N||5|||26 || I tell you the truth, if there is not a penny that has not been repaid, you will never come out from there.
023262 40N||5|||27||You have heard it said: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
023263 40N||5|||28 || But I say to you, whoever lusts after a woman at the sight of her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
023264 40N||5|||29||If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away. It is better to lose one part of your body than to have your whole body thrown into hell.
023265 40N||5|||30||If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is better to lose one of your body parts than to have your whole body go to hell.
023266 40N||5|||31||There is another saying: If a man divorces his wife, he should give him a letter of divorcement.
023267 40N||5|||32 || But I say to you, whoever divorces his wife, unless it is for sexual immorality, commits adultery; and whoever marries such a divorced woman also commits adultery.
023268 40N||5|||33||You have also heard what was commanded to the ancients, saying: You must not break your oaths, but you must always keep the oaths you have sworn to the Lord.
023269 40N||5|||34||I just tell you that you must not take any oath. Do not swear by heaven, for heaven is the seat of God;
023270 40N||5|||35||You shall not swear by the earth, for it is his footstool; nor shall you swear by Jerusalem, for Jerusalem is the capital of your Majesty;
023271 40N||5|||36 || And you cannot swear by your head, because you cannot make a hair black or white.
023272 40N||5|||37 || If your words are yes, say yes; if they are not yes, say no; if you say more, they are from the evil one (or: they are out of evil).
023273 40N||5|||38||You have heard it said: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth.
023274 40N||5|||39||I’m just telling you, don’t fight against evil people. If someone slaps you on the right side of your cheek, turn your left cheek to him as well;
023275 40N||5|||40||Someone wants to sue you and take away your inner clothes, and even your outer clothes are taken away by them;
023276 40N||5|||41||If someone forces you to walk one mile, go with him two miles;
023277 40N||5|||42||Give it to anyone who asks for something from you; don’t turn away anyone who asks for a loan from you.
023278 40N||5|||43||You have heard it said: Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.
023279 40N||5|||44 || But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.
023280 40N||5|||45||So that you may be sons of your Father who is in heaven; for He makes his sun rise on the good and on the evil, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
023281 40N||5|||46||If you only love those who love you, what reward will you get? Even a tax collector can do this, right?
023282 40N||5|||47||If you just ask for greetings from your brothers, what advantage do you have over others? Isn’t it okay even for foreigners?
023283 40N||5|||48||Therefore, be perfect, just as your heavenly Father is perfect.
023284 40N||6|||1||Be careful not to do your good deeds in front of others and deliberately let them see them. If you do this, you will not be rewarded by your Father in Heaven.
023285 40N||6|||2||Therefore when you give alms, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, who seek to gain glory from men. Truly, I say to you, they have received their reward.
023286 40N||6|||3||When you give alms, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.

029517 51N||2|||22||This is according to what one has commanded and taught. Speaking of which, everything is ruined when it is being used.
029518 51N||2|||23 || These rules make people have the name of wisdom, worship with selfish intentions, show themselves to be humble, and treat their bodies harshly. In fact, they have no effect in restraining the lust of the body.
029519 51N||3|||1||Therefore, if you have been raised with Christ, seek the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
029520 51N||3|||2||Set your minds on things above, not on things on earth.
029521 51N||3|||3||For you have died and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
029522 51N||3|||4||When Christ appears, who is our life, you also will appear with him in glory.
029523 51N||3|||5||Therefore put to death the members of your body that are on earth, fornication, impurity, evil passions, evil desires, and greed. Greed is the same as idolatry.
029524 51N||3|||6||Because of these things, the wrath of God will come on the sons of disobedience.
029525 51N||3|||7||You also did this when you were living in these things.
029526 51N||3|||8 || But now you are to renounce all such things, along with anger, anger, malice, slander, and filthy language from your mouth.
029527 51N||3|||9||Do not lie to one another; for you have put off the old man and its deeds,
029528 51N||3|||10||Put on a new person. The new man is gradually renewed in knowledge, being conformed into the image of his Lord who created him.
029529 51N||3|||11||There is no distinction here between Greeks and Jews, circumcised and uncircumcised, aliens, Scythians, slaves and free, but Christ is all in himself and dwells in them all. .
029530 51N||3|||12||Therefore, as God’s chosen people, holy and beloved, have a spirit of mercy, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
029531 51N||3|||13||If this person has a problem with that person, always tolerate and forgive each other; just as the Lord has forgiven you, you must also forgive others.
029532 51N||3|||14||Beyond all this, there must be love, which is the link between all virtues.
029533 51N||3|||15 || Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to which also you were called into one body; and be thankful.
029534 51N||3|||16 ||Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, with all wisdom, in psalms, hymns, Spiritual songs, teaching and admonishing each other, singing praises to God with hearts moved by grace.
029535 51N||3|||17||Whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
029536 51N||3|||18||Wives, be subject to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
029537 51N||3|||19 || Husbands, you must love your wives and do not treat them harshly.
029538 51N||3|||20||Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
029539 51N||3|||21||Fathers, do not offend your children, lest they lose their ambition.
029540 51N||3|||22||You servants, be obedient in all things to your masters of the body. Do not serve only in front of your eyes, as if you were pleasing others, but be sincere in your heart and fear the Lord.
029541 51N||3|||23||No matter what you do, you must do it from your heart, as if you are doing it for the Lord, not for others.
029542 51N||3|||24||For you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward; it is the Lord Christ whom you serve.
029543 51N||3|||25||Whoever does injustice will receive the retribution of injustice; the Lord is no respecter of persons.

029562 52N||1|||1||Paul, Silas, and Timothy to the Church in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ in Thessalonica. May the favor return to you in peace!
029563 52N||1|||2||We thank God always for you all and mention you in our prayers,
029564 52N||1|||3||In the presence of God our Father, remember without ceasing your work of faith, your labor of love, your patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
029565 52N||1|||4||O brothers beloved by God, I know that you are chosen;
029566 52N||1|||5 || For our gospel came to you not only with words, but also with power and the Holy Spirit, and with full faith, just as you know how we behaved in you for your sakes.
029567 52N||1|||6||And you, who received the truth with joy in the midst of great tribulation, and were imitated by us, and also imitated the Lord;
029568 52N||1|||7||So much so that you became an example to everyone in Macedonia and Achaia who believes in the Lord.
029569 52N||1|||8||For the word of the Lord has been proclaimed from you. Your faith in God is proclaimed everywhere, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place; so there is no need for us to say anything.

029571 52N||1|||10||Waiting for the coming of his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead - Jesus who saves us from the wrath to come.
029572 52N||2|||1||You yourselves, brothers, know that our entry into you is not in vain.
029573 52N||2|||2||We were suffered and humiliated in Philippi, as you know; yet we were bold in our God, and preached the gospel of God to you in the midst of the great conflict.
029574 52N||2|||3||Our counsel is not from error, nor from filthiness, nor from deceit.
029575 52N||2|||4||But since God has tested us and entrusted us with the gospel, we should speak the same way, not to please others, but to please God, who tests our hearts.
029576 52N||2|||5 || Because we have never used flattering words, which you know, nor have we hidden greed, as God can bear witness.
029577 52N||2|||6||As apostles of Christ, although we can be respected by others, we do not seek glory from you or others;
029578 52N||2|||7||But be gentle among you, as a mother nurses her own child.
029579 52N||2|||8|| Since we love you so much, we are not only willing to give you the gospel of God, but we are also willing to give you our own lives, because you are the ones we love.
029580 52N||2|||9||Brothers, remember our hard work, which worked day and night to preach the gospel of God to you, so that none of you would be burdened.
029581 52N||2|||10||We declare to you who believe in the Lord how holy, righteous, and blameless we are, with you as your witnesses and God as your witness.
029582 52N||2|||11||You also know how we exhorted you, comforted you, and charged each of you, just as a father does to his own children,
029583 52N||2|||12|| That you should conduct yourself worthy of God, who calls you into his kingdom and his glory.
029584 52N||2|||13||For this we cannot cease to thank God, because when you heard the word of God which we preached, you received it, not as the word of men, but as the word of God. This Word is indeed God’s and operates in the hearts of you who believe in the Lord.
029585 52N||2|||14||Brothers, you were imitators of the churches of God in Christ Jesus, which are in Judea; for you also suffered from the natives, just as they suffered from the Jews.
029586 52N||2|||15||These Jews killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove us out. They displease God and are enemies of everyone;
029587 52N||2|||16||We are not allowed to preach to the Gentiles so that they may be saved, for we are always full of our own sins. God's wrath has come to them to the extreme.
029588 52N||2|||17||Brothers, we are temporarily separated from you, but we are separated in face, but not in our hearts; we are trying our best to think of ways to see you face to face.
029589 52N||2|||18||So we wanted to come to you; I, Paul, once or twice wanted to go, but Satan prevented us.
029590 52N||2|||19||What is our hope and joy and crown of boasting? Will you not be able to stand before our Lord Jesus when He comes?
029591 52N||2|||20||Because you are our glory and our joy.
029592 52N||3|||1||Since we can endure it no longer, we are willing to wait alone in Athens,
029593 52N||3|||2||Sent our brother Timothy, a minister of God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen you and to encourage you in the faith,
029594 52N||3|||3||Lest anyone be shaken by various adversities. Because you yourselves know that we are destined to suffer hardships.
029595 52N||3|||4||While we were with you, we warned you beforehand that we would be in trouble, and it came to pass, and you know it.
029596 52N||3|||5||For this reason, since I could endure it no longer, I sent to you to find out what kind of faith you had, lest the tempter might have deceived you after all, and made our labor in vain.

029599 52N||3|||8||If you stand firm in the Lord, we will live.

029605 52N||4|||1||Brothers, I have one more thing to say: We beg and exhort you through the Lord Jesus, that as you have been taught by us and know how to do what is pleasing to God, do more what you do now. Encourage.
029606 52N||4|||2||For you know what commandments we have given you by the Lord Jesus Christ.
029607 52N||4|||3||It is the will of God that you should be holy and avoid sexual immorality;
029608 52N||4|||4 || Let each of you know how to guard your body with holiness and dignity.
029609 52N||4|||5||Do not indulge in evil desires like those of the Gentiles who do not know God.
029610 52N||4|||6 || Let no one overdo this by taking advantage of his brother; for such things are repaid by the Lord, as I have forewarned you, and have most earnestly commanded you.
029611 52N||4|||7||God calls us not to be polluted, but to be holy.
029612 52N||4|||8||Therefore he who rejects you does not reject man, but God, who gives you the Holy Spirit.
029613 52N||4|||9||Concerning the love one to another, brethren, there is no need for anyone to write to you; for you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
029614 52N||4|||10||Although you do this to all the brothers in Macedonia and throughout the land, I urge you to encourage them even more.
029615 52N||4|||11||Again, be determined to be quiet people, mind your own business, and work with your hands, just as we commanded you before,
029616 52N||4|||12||So that you may behave righteously toward outsiders, and you will not lack anything yourself.
029617 52N||4|||13||We do not want you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning those who sleep, lest you should be grieved, as are those who have no hope.
029618 52N||4|||14||If we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even those who sleep in Jesus will God also bring with him.
029619 52N||4|||15 || Now we tell you one thing, according to the word of the Lord: We who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.
029620 52N||4|||16||For the Lord Himself will come from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trumpet of God; and the dead in Christ will be raised first.
029621 52N||4|||17||Afterwards, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. In this way, we will be with the Lord forever.
029622 52N||4|||18||Therefore, you should use these words to comfort each other.

029626 52N||5|||4||But you, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should come upon you like thieves.
029627 52N||5|||5||You are all children of light, you are all children of day. We do not belong to the night, nor do we belong to the darkness.
029628 52N||5|||6||So let us not sleep like others, but always be alert and sober.
029629 52N||5|||7||Because people who are asleep sleep at night, and people who are drunk are drunk at night.

029636 52N||5|||14 || We also exhort our brethren to warn the unruly, encourage the discouraged, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
029637 52N||5|||15 || You must be careful, and no one should repay evil for evil; or treat each other, or treat others, always pursue good.
029638 52N||5|||16||Be happy always,
029639 52N||5|||17||Pray without ceasing,

029698 54N||1|||1||Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, by the command of God our Savior and our hope,
029699 54N||1|||2||Write to Timothy, who is my true son through faith in the Lord. May grace, mercy, and peace be to you from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord!
029700 54N||1|||3||When I went to Macedonia, I advised you to stay in Ephesus so that you could give instructions to those people not to teach heresy.
029701 54N||1|||4||Neither should you listen to unsubstantiated words and endless genealogies; these things only produce debates, and do not discover the laws of God which have been established in faith.
029702 54N||1|||5||But the bottom line of command is love; this love is born from a pure heart, a good conscience, and a faith without hypocrisy.
029703 54N||1|||6||Some people deviate from these and instead speak empty words,
029704 54N||1|||7||I want to be a Dharma teacher, but I don’t understand what I say and conclude.
029705 54N||1|||8||We know that the law is good, provided it is used appropriately;
029706 54N||1|||9||For the law is not for the righteous, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the impious and sinners, for the unholy and worldly, for the parricide and murderer,
029707 54N||1|||10||Whoever commits adultery and has sex with men, who robs people and tells lies, and who swears false oaths, or who sets up for anything else that is hostile to righteousness.
029708 54N||1|||11||This is according to the gospel of glory entrusted to me by the blessed God.
029709 54N||1|||12||I give thanks to Christ Jesus our Lord, who gives me strength, because He considered me faithful and appointed me to serve Him.
029710 54N||1|||13||I was once a blasphemer, a persecutor, and an arrogant; yet I received mercy, because I did it when I did not believe and did not understand.
029711 54N||1|||14||And the grace of our Lord is exceedingly abundant, giving me faith and love in Christ Jesus.
029712 54N||1|||15||Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners. These words are believable and very admirable. I am the chief sinner among sinners.
029713 54N||1|||16||Nevertheless, I received mercy, because Jesus Christ would demonstrate in me, the chief of sinners, all his longsuffering, as an example to those who would later believe in him for eternal life.
029714 54N||1|||17 || May the honor and glory be with the immortal, invisible, eternal King, the only God, forever and ever. Amen!
029715 54N||1|||18||My son Timothy, I entrust you with this command, according to the prophecy that was given to you in the past, so that you may thereby fight the good fight.
029716 54N||1|||19||Always have confidence and a clear conscience. Someone who abandons his conscience is like a shipwrecked ship on the true path.
029717 54N||1|||20||Among them were Hymenaeus and Alexander; I handed them over to Satan, so that they might be punished and no longer slander them.

029720 54N||2|||3||This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior.
029721 54N||2|||4||He wants all people to be saved and understand the true way.

029811 55N||1|||1||Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,

030524 61N||3|||1||Dear brothers, I am writing to you now my second letter. These two letters are to remind you and inspire your honest heart.

030526 61N||3|||3||First of all, you should know that in the last days there will be scoffers who will follow their own selfish desires and ridicule, saying:
030527 61N||3|||4||“Where is the promise of the coming of the Lord? For since the fathers fell asleep all things remain the same as they were from the beginning of creation.”
030528 61N||3|||5||They deliberately forget that from time immemorial, the sky was created by God’s command, and the earth came out of water and was created by borrowing water.
030529 61N||3|||6||Therefore, the world at that time was destroyed by being flooded.
030530 61N||3|||7||But the heavens and the earth that are now exist by that destiny, until the day when the ungodly will be judged and perish, and burned with fire.
030531 61N||3|||8||Dear brothers, there is one thing you must not forget, that is, in the eyes of the Lord, one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like one day.
030532 61N||3|||9||The Lord has not yet fulfilled His promise, and some think He is delaying. In fact, He is not delaying, but He is tolerant of you. He does not want any of you to perish, but He wants all to repent.
030533 61N||3|||10||But the day of the Lord will be like a thief coming. On that day, the sky will fall away with a loud noise, everything with form and substance will be destroyed by the fierce fire, and the earth and everything on it will be burned up.
030534 61N||3|||11||Since all of this has to be transformed in this way, how holy and godly should you be as people,

031070 66N||21|||16||The city is square, and its length and width are the same. Heaven used reeds to measure the city. It was four thousand miles in total, and its length, breadth, and height were all the same.
031071 66N||21|||17||And they measured the wall of the city, according to the measure of men, which is the measure of angels, and they were one hundred and forty-four cubits.
031072 66N||21|||18||The walls are made of jasper; the city is made of fine gold, like clear glass.
031073 66N||21|||19||The foundations of the city wall were decorated with various precious stones: the first foundation was jasper; the second foundation was sapphire; the third foundation was green agate; the fourth foundation was emerald;
031074 66N||21|||20||The fifth is red agate; the sixth is ruby; the seventh is yellow jade; the eighth is azure; the ninth is red jade; the tenth is emerald; the eleventh is purple agate; the twelfth is amethyst.
031075 66N||21|||21||The twelve gates are twelve pearls, and each gate is a pearl. The streets in the city were made of pure gold, like clear glass.
031076 66N||21|||22||I have not seen a temple in the city, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temples.
031077 66N||21|||23||The city does not need the light of the sun or the moon to shine in it; for the glory of God shines in it, and the Lamb is its lamp.
031078 66N||21|||24||The nations will walk in the light of the city; and the kings of the earth will give their glory to that city.
031079 66N||21|||25||The city gate is never closed during the day, and there is no night there.
031080 66N||21|||26 || People will return to that city the glory and honor of the nations.
031081 66N||21|||27||No one who is unclean shall enter that city, nor anyone who does what is abominable and false, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb's Book of Life.
031082 66N||22|||1||And the angel showed me that in the midst of the streets of the city a river of the water of life, bright as crystal, would flow from the throne of God and of the Lamb.
031083 66N||22|||2 || On this side of the river and on that side is the tree of life, which bears twelve kinds of fruit, and bears fruit every month; and the leaves on the tree are for the healing of all peoples.
031084 66N||22|||3||There will be no more curse; for in the city is the throne of God and of the Lamb; and His servants shall serve Him,
031085 66N||22|||4||I also want to see him face to face. His name must be written on their foreheads.
031086 66N||22|||5||There will be no more night; they will have no need of lamps or sunlight, for the Lord God will give them light. They will be kings forever and ever.
031087 66N||22|||6||The angel said to me again: These words are true and trustworthy. The Lord is the God of the inspired spirits of the prophets, who sends His messengers to show His servants what must be done quickly.
031088 66N||22|||7||Behold, I must come quickly! Blessed are those who obey the prophecies in this book!
031089 66N||22|||8 || These things I, John, heard and saw; and when I heard and saw them, I fell down at the feet of the angel who showed me, and worshiped him.
031090 66N||22|||9||He said to me: Never! I am a servant to you and your brothers, the prophets, and those who keep the words of this book. You have to worship God.
031091 66N||22|||10|| He also said to me: The prophecies in this book cannot be sealed because the date is near.
031092 66N||22|||11||He who is unjust, let him be unjust still; and he who is filthy, let him be filthy still; and he who is righteous, let him be righteous still; and he who is holy, let him be holy still.
031093 66N||22|||12||Look, I must come quickly! Rewards and punishments are in my hands, and I will repay everyone according to what they have done.
031094 66N||22|||13||I am the Alpha and the Omega; I am the First and the Last; I am the Beginning and the End.
031095 66N||22|||14||Blessed are those who wash their clothes! But if you have the authority to go to the tree of life, you can also enter the city through the gate.
031096 66N||22|||15 || Outside the city there are dogs, those who practice magic, those who commit adultery, those who kill people, those who worship idols, and anyone who loves to tell lies and fabricate falsehoods.
031097 66N||22|||16||I, Jesus, sent my messenger to testify these things to you, the churches. I am the root of David, and I am his descendant. I am the bright morning star.
031098 66N||22|||17||The Holy Spirit and the Bride both say: Come! Those who hear it should also say: Come! Let him who is thirsty come; and whoever wishes, let him drink of the water of life freely.
031099 66N||22|||18 || I testify to everyone who hears the prophecies in this book, that if anyone adds anything to this prophecy, God will add to him the disasters that are written in this book;
031100 66N||22|||19||If anyone takes away anything from the prophecies in this book, God will take away his part from the tree of life and the holy city that are written in this book.
031101 66N||22|||20||The one who proves this said: Yes, I will come soon! Amen! Lord Jesus, I want you to come!
031102 66N||22|||21||May the grace of the Lord Jesus be always with all the saints. Amen!
